added_findings.title: Transitions opt-in would strip the Walk exit from VV's plan and elevation entries
added_findings.detail: VV Transitions 1.0.0 SuspendThreeD() always leaves Walk/Fly, through Na__NavToolbar__SetOrbitMode. Three VV callers rely on that: the Layout Editor (ModeController:524), the floor plan controller (43/Na__FloorPlan__ModeController__.js:465) and the elevation controller (46/Na__Elevation__ModeController__.js:526). A fourth caller, the snapshot renderer (51/25/Na__LayoutEditor__SnapshotRenderer__.js:501), does NOT want it. It suspends around every viewport picture, so a picture rendered from the 3D tab (a bake, a quiet re-stamp after a drawing rename) drops a walker back to Orbit. TV removed that behaviour in Transitions 1.1.0 (v2.112.0). TV's own plan and elevation controllers never call Transitions, so TV only had to pass the option from the Layout Editor (:707). S02a's WP-S02a-11 ports the opt-in and names only the Layout Editor caller.
added_findings.recommendation: When Transitions 1.1.0 lands (S02a WP-S02a-11; ReturnToOrbit = VV's Na__NavToolbar__SetOrbitMode), pass { returnToOrbit : true } from all three VV drawing entries (Layout Editor, floor plan, elevation) in the same change. Leave the snapshot renderer call bare. Acceptance: entering a plan, an elevation or a drawing tab while walking leaves Walk; baking or re-stamping a viewport picture from the 3D tab while walking does not.
added_findings.evidence: VV grep of Na__DrawView__Transitions__SuspendThreeD callers: 51 ModeController:524, 43 FloorPlan MC:465, 46 Elevation MC:526, 51/25 SnapshotRenderer:501. TV callers: LE ModeController:707 (with the option), SnapshotRenderer:905 (bare). TV Transitions 1.1.0 log; S02a WP-S02a-11.

added_findings.title: VV 3D hotkey dictionary dispatches its documentation rows
added_findings.detail: Na__ValeVision__HotkeysDictionary__.json holds ten ValeVision__DrawingMarkup__Contextual rows (D, O, Arrows, Alt, Shift, Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y, Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V, Delete, Escape). They sit in the same array the handler dispatches, so that they can be listed in the help panel's Advanced fold. index.html registers no callback for that action, and the handler calls preventDefault BEFORE it dispatches (HotkeyHandler__.js:91-101). So a bare D, O, Delete or Escape, outside a text field and on any tab, is taken from the browser and logs 'No callback for action ValeVision__DrawingMarkup__Contextual' on every press. TV's 3D file keeps only dispatchable bindings in its array (15) and documents the context keys in separate reference blocks (Na__Hotkeys__Movement__Reference, Na__Hotkeys__Ui__Reference). Low impact today: the only VV listeners that check defaultPrevented are the mode controller's Ctrl+S handler and the Measurements box, and both run in the capture phase, before this handler.
added_findings.recommendation: With the key-scope guard (WP-S03a-V03), skip any binding whose action has no registered callback before calling preventDefault. Alternatively, move the documentation rows into a reference block (TV's shape) and have the navigation help panel read it. Either way, keep the rows visible in VV's help panel.

added_findings.title: First drawing tab after a document-tab entry: TV veils it, VV does not
added_findings.detail: TV's first-open veil runs once per session (Na__LeVeil__FirstUsed, LoadingVeil:124,317). It is skipped only for the quiet entry under a document tab (EnterUnder; Enter calls FirstOpen when !Quiet, ModeController:733). So when a session starts on the Specification, Register or Statements and the reader then opens a drawing, 'Your Drawings Are Loading' covers that first drawing while its viewports render. In VV the loader screen covers only the editor's first load; after that, WithEditor runs every action with no screen (Loader.js:388-422). A first drawing tab opened after a document tab therefore gets no cover. This becomes reachable once TabStrip 2.0.0 shows the document tabs from the 3D view.
added_findings.recommendation: Decide with D-S03a-09 / D-S03a-11. For the same behaviour as TV, have the loader show its screen on the first sheet view of a session whose editor was first loaded for a document view, waiting on WaitForFirstDrawing. This is a loader-only change, with no second overlay.

notes:
The slice is strong and mostly accurate. I opened all 16 critical and high findings against the files, plus 25 of the 31 medium and low ones. Independent recounts matched the survey: 356 AppConfig key differences, the 16 brand values, the misplaced TV labels, 59/36 key bindings, the 31-import mode controller walk, the 11-v-6 Ready chain, the 10/6 tab-strip CSS rules, the loader facade and the ledger contradiction. The top-bar fold is confirmed identical.

The main error: S03a-F15 and headline item 2 say VV keeps Walk running under the editor. That is wrong. VV's SuspendThreeD always runs the whole Walk/Fly exit through Na__NavToolbar__SetOrbitMode; TV's v2.112.0 bug was TV-only. What VV lacks is the opt-in, so that the snapshot renderer stops ejecting a walker. When that lands (S02a WP-S02a-11), VV's floor plan and elevation entries must pass the option too (S03a-V03).

Two recommendations would have broken VV:
- WP-S03a-01 takes TV's barrel ahead of KeyMap 1.11.0. That is a static-import link failure, and the editor would not load.
- WP-S03a-11 moves jsPDF and the Classic scan, but legacy 35 is still opened by Image Export. Copy instead.

One rename was incomplete: the 3D dictionary has a second consumer, the help panel.

Minor count fixes: 25 QR keys (16 settings + 9 notes), not 17; 10 ToolSetup getters, not 12. One wrong ledger citation (:240). The NOTES doc was misused as loader evidence.

Four work packages are replaced: WP-S03a-01/03/04/11 -> V01/V03/V04/V02. Dependants re-point: WP-02 -> V01; WP-05 and WP-12 -> V04; WP-09 -> V03/V04.

The planner must dedupe. KeyScope, the 3D-hotkey guard, the key-file rename and DocumentKeys are also proposed by S05a (WP-S05a-01/02/05) and S09 (WP-S09-05). Decisions D-S03a-01/02/04/09/10/05/06 duplicate D-S09-01/03/07/08 and D-S10-01/02/03/05. Nothing was run in a browser.
